about: The shared commands of the application. A shared command does nothing by itself: a plugin handles it with an entry of contributes.handlers and registers the handler under the id of the command. Run over a target, a command with one matching handler runs it, and a command with several offers the matching handlers as its items. `arguments` are declared once, as a manifest command declares them; the palette asks for them and the core checks them for every handler. tools/commands.mjs writes the Go and TypeScript lists from this file.

commands.about: creates a text version of a file
